data.name: Skyline Pool Service llc
data.address: 8333 Artesian Spring Dr, Fort Worth, TX 76131

reviews.text: I absolutely love these guys! I refer them to everyone I know. They are awesome! Customer service is by far the best I have ever had with pool services. They are always on time and so knowledgeable about all the pool systems. I can’t thank them enough! They fixed our pool from the freeze and did it cheerfully. 😊❤️
reviews.author: Michelle Christakis

reviews.text: Mr. Ever Merroquin and his associates do a wonderful job of keeping our family’s swimming pool clean, clear, and beautiful! They have even come out in emergency situations quickly and have expedited fixing the problems. I would highly recommend their services to anyone who would ask. They are professional, kind, caring, and knowledgeable.
reviews.author: Ricky Johnston

reviews.text: When we first moved into our home our pool was in dire need. Skyline Pool Service came highly recommended. Techs were skilled and able to get our pool crystal clear and have maintained it ever since. They have also assisted in helping us upgrade our pool equipment with new pumps, rerouting our plumbing as well as installation of the equipment. Their team is very dependable, prompt, and knowlegable. Owner of company is friendly and down to earth. He is very thorough in explaining things if you have questions and he doesn’t try to sell you stuff that you don’t need. I absolutely love that.  Highly recommend this pool service for their expertise, dependability and competitive pricing. 5 Stars+
reviews.author: Michael Garza

reviews.text: I am thoroughly impressed with their service. They are efficient, completing the job on the spot with cleanliness and professionalism. Their prices are affordable, and I confidently recommend them to all my friends and family.
reviews.author: Mo Hasan

reviews.text: My family has been using this pool service for a couple years now they referred me. The company is very knowledgeable about everything pool related. I recently moved into a new house where the previous owner didn’t do the due diligence the pool needed. Needless to say Skyline Pool Service made the necessary repairs to get it looking new again. I have been using their service for a couple months now and the pool looks crystal clear and blue just like an oasis should. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!
reviews.author: Rick Aguillon

reviews.text: Ever, The owner is more than helpful, honest and wants the customer to be happy. He makes sure you are involved every step of the way and is always willing to answer questions any time of the day. They did awesome work -I am SO in love with my new surface on my pool. I would refer Skyline Pools to anyone needing good honest work !!
reviews.author: DARLENE lee

reviews.text: Awesome owner and Team! Hard working, honest, dependable, personable, and professional. Best pool maintenance service in Fort Worth! Always takes care of everything as promised and never misses an appointment. Very knowledgeable, friendly staff, great communications for a reasonable price for the work performed. If you want a hassle free clean & beautiful pool year round go with Skyline Pool Service. They take care of everything, you won’t be disappointed.
reviews.author: Chad Carr

reviews.text: I have been using Skyline Pool Service for over ten years. Their weekly service is impeccable and I never have to worry about them showing up. They are like clockwork. If they have an issue I hear from them immediately. They can make all kinds of repairs and I’m very pleased with all of their work.
reviews.author: Steve Elwell

data.summary: The reviews appear highly authentic. The Google reviews, while a small sample, are detailed and varied. The massive review count on Angi (964) strongly indicates a legitimate, established business with a large customer base. There are no patterns of complaints or manipulation.
fake_signals: Small sample size on Google (16 reviews) could be curated
All 8 sampled Google reviews are 5-star with no negative feedback
authentic_signals: Reviews contain specific details (owner's name 'Ever Merroquin', specific repairs like post-freeze fixes, equipment upgrades)
Varied writing styles and perspectives (long-term customer, new customer, referral)
Mention of concrete outcomes (pool crystal clear, plumbing rerouted)
High volume on Angi (964 reviews) suggests established business with many real customers
data.discrepancy_explanation: No significant discrepancies. Google shows a perfect 5.0 with 16 reviews, and Angi shows a strong 4.4 with a very high volume (964 reviews). The lack of BBB and Yelp data is not unusual for a local service business.
